title: answers stream research_progress record (v1)
description: One research-family event of a streamed answers run — a queries, analyzing, thinking, progress, or blindspots tag — carrying the tag that closed beside its parsed JSON payload.

payload.$comment: The tag's validated JSON payload, carried as parsed. The decoder guarantees exactly one valid JSON document; the upstream contract leaves research-tag shapes unverified, so any JSON value rides here, not only an object.
